args.title: Adjust error toast announcement and visibility
args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Change the `aria-live` attribute for error toasts from "polite" to "assertive" to ensure they are announced immediately by screen readers. Disable automatic dismissal for error toasts to ensure that they remain on screen until actively dismissed by the user.
